pages.title: はじめに
pages.text: $(thing)Pets$() are animals that function similarly to $(l:agriculture/animal_husbandry)Livestock$(). Instead of products, pets are useful for obeying commands, being friends, pest control, hunting.$(br)Pets recognize a certain player as their $(thing)Owner$(). To become a pet's owner, feed it to raise its familiarity above $(item)15%$(). Pets will only obey commands that come from their owner.$(br)Clicking on a pet with $(thing)dye$() changes its collar color.

pages.title: Dogs
pages.text: Dogs are a pet that eats grains, vegetables, and meat, rotten or not rotten. They will help you hunt almost any land predator or prey.$(br)Dogs come in multiple variants that depend on what type of $(l:the_world/wild_animals#wolf)wolf$() it was domesticated from.

pages.title: Cats
pages.text: Cats are a pet that eats grains, cooked meats, and dairy products. They will help you hunt land prey and small fish. When at home, they will kill pests without being asked. Cats do not always listen when being told to sit.$(br2)Variants: Black, British Shorthair, Calico, Jellie, Persian, Ragdoll, Red, Siamese, Tabby, White.
As villages do not exist, taming an $(l:the_world/wild_animals#ocelot)Ocelot$() is the only way to obtain a cat.

pages.title: Foxes
pages.text: Foxes are a pet that eats any edible food. They will help you hunt land prey and small fish. When at home, they will kill pests without being asked. Foxes do not always listen when being told to sit.$(br2)Variants: Red, Snow.

pages.title: Pigeons
pages.text: Pigeons are capable of being tamed and delivering packages, but do not follow standard commands. You can feed $(t:#fowlplay:pigeon_food)$(6)Pigeon Food$(), such as grains and vegetables, to a pigeon to tame it.$(br)Once tamed a pigeon can deliver $(t:#fowlplay:pigeon_deliverable)$(6)Sacks$() to other players by $(l:craftsmanship/scribing_table)naming the pouch$() with the player's name before handing it over.

pages.title: Commands
pages.text: Responsible pet owners must learn to control their pet. Luckily, this is easy. By pressing $(item)$(k:key.use)$() while holding $(item)$(k:key.sneak)$() with an empty hand, the $(thing)Pet Screen$() may be opened. This screen contains a number of commands that can be used to tell the pet what to do: $(thing)Relax$(), $(thing)We're Home$(), $(thing)Sit$(), $(thing)Follow Me$(), and $(thing)Hunt With Me$().

pages.title: 自由にしてて
pages.text: $(thing)リラックス$()はペットの基本状態であり、この命令を出すとペットは通常の状態に戻ります。家にいる場合は敷地内を自由に歩き回りますが、外へ出ることはなく、1日に1回眠ります。家から離れすぎている場合は、その場をあてもなく歩き回ります。

pages.title: Home
pages.text: $(thing)ハウス$()は、ペットのホーム地点を設定します。これにより、ペットはリラックス中にその周辺エリアで過ごすようになります。この命令を出しても、現在行っている行動は中断されません。$(br2)$(thing)おすわり$()は、その場に座るようペットに指示します。ただし、動物にも自分の意思があるため、しばらくすると退屈して立ち上がってしまいます！

pages.title: Hunt
pages.text: $(thing)狩り$()を選ぶと、ペットはあなたについて来て、あなたが攻撃した相手や、あなたを攻撃した相手と戦ってくれます。ただし、ペットは自分で対処できる相手にしか攻撃しません（たとえば、猫やキツネはクマとの戦いを手伝うことはできません！）。$(br2)$(thing)追従$()は「狩り」とほぼ同じですが、ペットは戦闘に参加して自らを危険にさらすことはありません。

pages.title: ペットのおやつ
pages.text: $(thing)Pet Treats$() can be made by mixing medicine with bone meal.$(br)Pet treats give $(bold)massive$() stat bonuses to your pets for a short duration.

pages.title: Name Tag
pages.text: $(thing)Name Tags$() can be crafted from paper and string. Once made, they can be edited on a $(l:craftsmanship/scribing_table)Scribing Table$() to give them a custom name that will transfer to your pet with $(item)$(k:key.use)$().

pages.title: 鉛
pages.text: A $(thing)Lead$() can be crafted from burlap fiber or string, and a metal ring.$(br)You can $(item)$(k:key.use)$() an animal with a lead to pull them around. Much more efficient than baiting them with food!$(br2)You can also pick up some smaller animals with $(item)$(k:key.sneak) + $(k:key.use)$() with empty hands.
